content.title: About
content.content: Beef steak NFS is a premium cut taken from the loin of the cow. It is known for its tender flavor, juiciness, and characteristic marbling, making it perfect for grilling, pan‑searing or roasting.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: NFS (No Fat Separation) indicates minimal fat loss during cooking.
Beef steak is one of the richest sources of iron and zinc.
Meat quality depends heavily on cattle breed, rearing conditions and aging process.
Traditionally the steak is cooked to medium‑rare to preserve maximum flavor and moisture.
Beef contains all essential amino acids required by the human body.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Beef steak provides complete protein that supports muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Rich in iron
items.content: Heme iron from beef is highly bioavailable and helps prevent anemia.

items.title: Source of vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 is essential for nervous system function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Contains zinc
items.content: Zinc supports immune function, wound healing and DNA synthesis.

items.title: Creatine and carnitine
items.content: These compounds boost muscular energy and aid recovery after intense exercise.

items.title: High saturated fat content
items.content: Excessive consumption of red meat may raise cholesterol levels and increase cardiovascular risk.

items.title: Bacterial contamination risk
items.content: Undercooked meat can harbor pathogens such as E. coli; cook to a safe internal temperature.

items.title: Allergy or sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to beef, especially if they have a food allergy.

items.title: Digestive issues
items.content: Large portions of red meat can cause heaviness, indigestion or constipation in sensitive people.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The steak is best cooked over high heat—grill, pan‑sear or roast to the desired doneness. Let the meat rest at room temperature for 20‑30 minutes before cooking. Serve with vegetables, sauces, or simply season with salt and freshly ground pepper.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the steak refrigerated at 0‑4 °C in its original packaging or an airtight container for 3‑5 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C in a vacuum‑sealed bag; it will keep up to 6 months. Thaw frozen steak in the refrigerator before cooking.
